title: Alabama Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Alabama's state tax agency.
notes: Home page; domain confirmed by many official results.

title: My Alabama Taxes (MAT)
purpose: File returns, make payments and manage most Alabama state tax accounts online.
notes: ADOR pages and PDFs name https://myalabamataxes.alabama.gov as the MAT portal; sign-up info at https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/individual-corporate/my-alabama-taxes-sign-up/ (official-result).

title: Individual Income Tax
purpose: Information on Alabama individual income tax filing, rates and requirements.

title: Corporate Income Tax (Income Tax Division)
purpose: Information on Alabama corporate income tax and other income taxes administered by the Income Tax Division.
notes: Division page covering corporate income tax (Forms 20C/20CC), partnerships, S corps, withholding, and business privilege tax.

title: Business Privilege Tax
purpose: Information on Alabama's annual business privilege tax owed by corporations and LLCs.
notes: Separate annual tax based on net worth (Forms CPT, PPT, BPT-IN).

title: Sales Tax
purpose: Information on Alabama state sales tax, rates and filing.
notes: Local sales taxes also apply; rates at https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/sales-use/tax-rates/ (official-result).

title: Withholding Tax (FAQs and guidance)
purpose: Employer guidance on Alabama income tax withholding registration, filing and payment.
notes: No standalone withholding tax-type page surfaced; this is the official withholding FAQ category. 2026 Withholding Tax Tables booklet: https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/whbooklet_0126.pdf (official-result). Registration and filing through My Alabama Taxes.

title: UC Employer Information
purpose: Employer information on registering for and paying Alabama unemployment compensation tax.
notes: Agency formerly the Alabama Department of Labor. Employer eGov login: https://labor.alabama.gov/egov/login.aspx (official-result).

title: How to Start or Dissolve a Business
purpose: Information on forming or dissolving a business entity with the Alabama Secretary of State.
notes: Business Entities hub: https://www.sos.alabama.gov/business-entities (official-result). Some older text on this site references filing via county probate judges; current forms are filed with the SOS.

title: Corporation Annual Report (form)
purpose: Annual report form for domestic and foreign for-profit corporations filed with the Secretary of State.
notes: Since Jan 1, 2024 for-profit corporation annual reports are filed with the SOS (not with the ADOR business privilege tax return), per ADOR. LLCs, LPs and nonprofits have no annual report. An SOS Business Entities page text appeared to say corporations no longer need to file; conflicting sources, so confirm. Business privilege tax return still filed annually with ADOR.

title: Business and License Division
purpose: Information on Alabama state and county business privilege licenses, which are purchased from the county probate judge or license commissioner.
notes: State/county licenses issued at county level and renewed each October; city licenses are separate.

title: ABC Board - How to Apply
purpose: Steps and forms to apply for an Alabama alcoholic beverage license or permit.
notes: License types and fees: https://alabcboard.gov/licensing-compliance/license-types-fees (official-result).

title: ABC Board - Tax & Trade Practices (FAQ)
purpose: Information from the ABC Board, which collects Alabama beer and wine excise taxes from wholesalers, manufacturers and importers.
notes: Monthly beer/table wine tax returns are filed with the ABC Board Tax & Trade Practices Division (forms revised 01/2026 on alabcboard.gov). No dedicated tax landing page confirmed; FAQ page used. ADOR administers related sales tax guidance.

title: Domestic Nonprofit Corporation Certificate of Incorporation
purpose: Form and information for incorporating an Alabama nonprofit corporation.
notes: Official-result page title matches but URL is a node link; 2024 form PDF: https://www.sos.alabama.gov/sites/default/files/2023-12/NonProfitIncorporation.pdf (official-result). Name reservation required first.

title: Licensing and Registration (Charities)
purpose: Registration of charitable organizations and professional fundraisers that solicit in Alabama.
agency: Alabama Attorney General - Consumer Interest Division
notes: Registration with the Attorney General required for charities soliciting in Alabama, with listed exemptions.

title: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
purpose: Home page of Alaska's state tax agency.
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division

title: Revenue Online
purpose: File and pay Alaska state tax returns and manage tax accounts online.
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
notes: Tax Division instruction text names Revenue Online at online-tax.alaska.gov and says it is reachable from tax.alaska.gov; URL did not appear as a direct result. Confirm before publishing.

title: Individual Income Tax
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
notes: Alaska has no state individual income tax.

title: Corporate Income Tax - E-file (MeF)
purpose: Information on filing and paying Alaska corporate income tax electronically.
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
notes: Specific corporate income tax index page did not surface; MeF page used. Corporate income tax FAQ: http://www.tax.alaska.gov/programs/programs/help/faq/faq.aspx?60380= (official-result).

title: Sales Tax
notes: Alaska has no statewide sales tax; many boroughs and cities levy local sales taxes administered locally (see https://www.commerce.alaska.gov/web/dcra/OfficeoftheStateAssessor/AlaskaSalesTaxInformation.aspx).

title: Income Tax Withholding
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
notes: Alaska has no state individual income tax, so there is no state income-tax withholding.

title: Employment Security Tax / Unemployment Insurance
purpose: Employer information and online access for Alaska unemployment insurance (employment security) tax.
agency: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development
notes: Result page is the general UI home; employer tax info lives under labor.alaska.gov/estax/ (e.g. TaxWeb instructions PDF https://www.labor.alaska.gov/estax/documents/TaxWeb_Instructions.pdf). Registration via my.alaska.gov. Dedicated employer tax landing page not confirmed.

title: Create or File for a New Entity
purpose: Form a new Alaska corporation, LLC or other entity.
agency: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing

title: Biennial Reports FAQs
purpose: Information on the biennial (every two years) reports Alaska entities must file.
agency: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
notes: Alaska uses biennial reports, not annual reports.

title: Business Licensing
purpose: Apply for or renew the Alaska Business License required for businesses operating in Alaska.
agency: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
notes: Statewide general business license required. Online application: https://www.commerce.alaska.gov/web/cbpl/BusinessLicensing/NewBLOnline.aspx (official-result).

title: Alcohol License Application
purpose: Forms and instructions to apply for an Alaska alcohol license.

title: Alcoholic Beverages Tax
purpose: Information on Alaska's alcoholic beverage excise tax, filed monthly mainly by wholesalers and distributors.
agency: Alaska Department of Revenue - Tax Division
notes: Paid to the Department of Revenue Tax Division (not AMCO). Result URL was http; https likely works.

title: NonProfit and Religious FAQs
purpose: Information on forming and maintaining an Alaska nonprofit corporation.
agency: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
notes: Filing itself is done via Create or File for a New Entity page.

title: Charity & Paid Solicitor Registration
purpose: Annual registration for charities and paid solicitors that solicit in Alaska.
agency: Alaska Department of Law - Consumer Protection Unit

title: Arizona Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Arizona's state tax agency.

title: AZTaxes.gov
purpose: File and pay Arizona transaction privilege (sales), use and withholding taxes, and make tax payments online.
notes: Domain confirmed via official result https://www.aztaxes.gov/Home/FAQ. Per its FAQ, only TPT, use tax and withholding returns are filed on AZTaxes; individual income returns are e-filed through other channels. Payments page: https://azdor.gov/make-payment-online (official-result).

title: Individual Income Tax Forms
purpose: Arizona individual income tax forms and instructions.
notes: A general individual income tax landing page was not confirmed; forms page and FAQ (https://azdor.gov/individual-income-tax-information/faq-during-tax-season) are official results. Arizona has a flat 2.5% rate.

title: Corporate Income Tax
purpose: Information on Arizona corporate income tax filing and payment.
notes: Forms 120/120A.

title: Transaction Privilege Tax (TPT) License
purpose: Information on getting and maintaining an Arizona TPT license, Arizona's sales-type tax on businesses.
notes: Arizona's sales tax is the transaction privilege tax (TPT), levied on the seller. Result is the TPT license page; a general TPT overview page was not confirmed. Business hub: https://azdor.gov/business (official-result).

title: Withholding Tax
purpose: Arizona employer income tax withholding information.
notes: No withholding-specific page URL confirmed (search budget exhausted). Employers register for withholding via the Joint Tax Application (JT-1) and file on AZTaxes.gov.

title: About Unemployment Insurance Tax
purpose: Employer information on Arizona unemployment insurance tax, rates and reporting.
notes: Quarterly reports/payments via the Tax and Wage System: https://des.az.gov/services/employment/unemployment-employer/tax-and-wage-system (official-result).

title: Corporation Forms
purpose: Forms for forming and maintaining Arizona corporations with the Corporation Commission.
notes: In Arizona, entities are registered with the Arizona Corporation Commission, not the Secretary of State. Corporation forms page confirmed; LLC formation page and the online Arizona Business Center URL not confirmed.

title: Business Services FAQs (Annual Reports)
purpose: Answers on filing Arizona corporation annual reports with the Corporation Commission.
notes: Dedicated annual-report filing page not confirmed. Corporations (including nonprofits) file annual reports; LLC requirement not confirmed in results. Note https://azcc.gov/transparency/annual-reports is the Commission's own agency report, not the filing page.

title: General Business License
notes: Could not confirm whether Arizona has a general statewide business license. The ADOR TPT license is required for businesses with taxable sales; cities may require their own licenses. Not marked NOT_APPLICABLE because unconfirmed.

title: Liquor License Application Instructions
purpose: Instructions and requirements for applying for an Arizona liquor license.
agency: Arizona Department of Liquor Licenses and Control
notes: PDF instructions; agency site https://www.azliquor.gov/. Local governing body recommendation required.

title: Liquor Luxury Tax
purpose: Information on Arizona's liquor luxury tax filed monthly by wholesalers, microbreweries, craft distillers and domestic farm wineries.
notes: Paid to the Department of Revenue (not the liquor department). Retail liquor sales are also subject to TPT.

title: Corporation Forms (nonprofit)
purpose: Forms for forming an Arizona nonprofit corporation with the Corporation Commission.
notes: Nonprofit-specific formation page not confirmed; corporation forms page is the closest official result. Nonprofit annual report fee listed on ACC 2026 fee schedule.

title: Veterans Charities Organizations
purpose: Registration for organizations soliciting in the name of a veterans' organization, the only charity filing still required by the Arizona Secretary of State.
notes: Per AZ SOS, HB 2457 (effective Sept 13, 2013) repealed the general charitable registration requirement; only veterans' organizations (A.R.S. 13-3722) must file, and no other agency assumed the filing.
